title: Training and Development Management
overview: Training and development professionals face ongoing pressure to deliver outstanding training services. To meet the demands of their roles, they must possess a comprehensive understanding of key topics within the training field. This course will provide participants with practical skills to advocate for training within their organizations, align training with organizational goals, assess training needs, and choose both internal trainers and external consultants. Additionally, the course emphasizes various levels of training evaluation and the competencies required for training professionals.
audience: This course is intended for training and development professionals engaged in training needs analysis, coordinating and organizing training programs, and evaluating training outcomes.
methodology: Participants will learn through practical application. The course incorporates several group exercises to help individuals apply theoretical concepts in real-world organizational contexts.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Articulate the strategic importance of training, particularly in aligning it with organizational strategy, promoting training within the organization, and collaborating with managers and supervisors
Develop suitable methods for conducting a Training Needs Assessment (TNA)
Explore strategies for selecting internal trainers and hiring external consultants
Demonstrate training success across all evaluation levels, from participant reactions to Return on Investment (ROI)
Identify foundational competencies for training professionals, along with essential actions and behaviors
